label: SoFIC system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a SoFIC locus represented by a SoFic profile that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: SoFIC branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual SoFic genes, SoFic proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one SoFIC locus, unresolved SoFIC trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
